news.title: Job candidates’ AI usage is obscuring their viability, report finds
news.summary: Nine in 10 employers worry they rejected a real applicant because they mistakenly believed a resume was fake or artificial intelligence-generated, according to a new study.

news.title: Employers should prepare for a labor market shake-up in 2027, Indeed and Glassdoor say
news.summary: Higher turnover and a need for a better leadership pipeline may be big concerns for talent leaders in the coming year, the hiring platforms predicted.

news.title: Bipartisan bill aims to secure more FMLA time for parents with NICU babies
news.summary: Supporters pointed to parents having to decide between using job-protected time to stay with their preterm newborn or for bonding later.

news.title: How to tackle employee pay cynicism
news.summary: Part of the solution is enhanced transparency “when you’ve got a good story to tell,” a global rewards solution leader said.

news.title: DOL flips independent contractor switch back with new final rule
news.summary: Secretary of Labor Keith Sonderling said the agency’s renewed “economic reality” test would provide greater clarity to both workers and employers.

news.title: Near-instant rejections may have changed job search behavior
news.summary: More than three-quarters of job seekers who received a fast rejection said they didn’t believe a human being had the time to review their resume before they were turned down.

news.title: Work done outside regular hours may count toward FMLA eligibility
news.summary: In an opinion letter, DOL also said that if accurate time records are not available, eligibility sometimes must be assumed.

news.title: Will more companies need to end their H-1B visa programs?
news.summary: While the math is shifting on immigration sponsorship, employers are still wary of “handing that talent to their competitors,” one attorney told HR Dive.

news.title: DHS’ 4-year cap on student visa stays struck down by federal judge
news.summary: The law does not grant the agency “such broad and open-ended authority to undermine” the student visa program, the judge wrote.

news.title: AI, rising costs top list of 2027 talent concerns, per Gartner
news.summary: Gartner researchers also highlighted the importance of entry-level workers, who are increasingly at risk due to AI.
